# Ezail AI Colleague

> Ezail is an AI-powered colleague that connects your Gmail and Google Calendar, providing always-available help via Telegram and WhatsApp. Get instant assistance whenever you need it, wherever you are.

**Tagline:** Connect your Gmail and Google Calendar. Get your executive assistant, always available to help you via messaging apps.

## Key Features

### Always Available
Interact with your AI assistant on the go via WhatsApp and Telegram. Get instant help whenever you need it, wherever you are.

### Smart Email Management
Connect your Gmail or Outlook to have your AI executive assistant highlight important emails and draft professional responses.

### Schedule Management
Connect your calendars to let your assistant manage your schedule, set reminders, and keep you organized.

### Powerful Capabilities
Your AI assistant can search the internet, do research, book restaurants and hotels, and much more—all at your command.

### Gets Smarter Over Time
As your assistant learns about you, your preferences, and your work style, it becomes even more effective and personalized.

### Constantly Improving
We're constantly and quickly improving Ezail with new features and capabilities to serve you better.

### Cloud Harness
Run your favorite coding agent — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Pi, and more — on a cloud computer you control from your messaging app. Send a task, close your laptop, and the result comes back as a message. Sandboxes start in seconds and the workspace persists between tasks.

### Outbound Voice Calls
Make phone calls on your behalf when online booking isn't available. Your assistant can call restaurants, businesses, and services to make reservations, gather information, or complete tasks that require a phone call.

### Private Email Inbox
Your AI colleague has its own private email address. Forward emails, documents, and attachments to your agent's inbox to give it context for searches and tasks. Share information seamlessly without cluttering your own inbox.

## Showcase Scenarios

### Email Management
**User:** "Check my inbox for urgent emails"  
**Assistant:** "I found 3 urgent emails. The most important is from your client about the Q4 presentation deadline."

**User:** "Draft a reply saying I'll have it ready by Friday"  
**Assistant:** "Done! I've drafted a professional response and saved it in your Gmail drafts for your review."

**Notification:** "You have 3 urgent emails requiring attention"

### Calendar Management
**User:** "Schedule a meeting with the marketing team next Tuesday"  
**Assistant:** "I've checked everyone's calendars. The best time is 2 PM. Should I send the invites?"

**User:** "Yes, and add the Q4 campaign deck to the invite"  
**Assistant:** "Meeting scheduled! Sent invites to 5 team members with the deck attached. I also added prep time to your calendar at 1:30 PM."

**Notification:** "Meeting scheduled with marketing team for Tuesday at 2 PM"

### Outbound Phone Calls
**User:** "Find me a good Italian restaurant for dinner tonight"  
**Assistant:** "I couldn't find a booking link, I will call the restaurant at +1 212 555 0123 to make a reservation for you."

**User:** "Perfect! Book for 2 people"  
**Assistant:** "Reservation confirmed for 2 at 7:30 PM! I've added it to your calendar and will remind you 1 hour before. Enjoy your dinner!"

**Notification:** "Dinner reservation confirmed via phone call"

### Company Tools Integration
**User:** "I spoke with our customer Acme and they agreed to upgrade to our enterprise plan, please update our sales team updates on Notion"  
**Assistant:** "Will do, should I also update Salesforce?"

**User:** "👍"  
**Assistant:** "Done! I've updated both Notion and Salesforce with the Acme upgrade details."

**Notification:** "Sales updates completed in Notion and Salesforce"

### Voice Messages
**User:** "[Voice message]"  
**Assistant:** "I heard your message about preparing for tomorrow's investor meeting. I've pulled together the Q4 metrics and created a summary deck."

**User:** "That's perfect, can you email it to the team?"  
**Assistant:** "Done! I've sent the deck to all 6 team members with a brief overview. The meeting is at 10 AM tomorrow—I'll send you a reminder at 9:30 AM."

**Notification:** "Investor meeting prep deck sent to team"

## Core Capabilities

### Email Intelligence
Automatically prioritize, summarize, and draft responses to your emails.

### Smart Scheduling
Coordinate meetings across calendars and find the perfect time for everyone.

### Outbound Phone Calls
Make calls on your behalf when online booking isn't available.

### Company Tools Integration
Update Notion, Salesforce, and other tools directly from your messages.

### Private Email Inbox
Your AI colleague has its own email address where you can forward documents and emails to give it context.

### Proactive Assistant
Research, book, and manage tasks before you even need to ask.

## Integrations

- **Gmail** - Connect your Google account to sync Gmail and Google Calendar
- **Outlook** - Connect your Microsoft account to sync Outlook and Microsoft Calendar
- **WhatsApp** - Primary interface for interacting with your assistant
- **Telegram** - Alternative interface for messaging your assistant
- **Private Email Inbox** - Your agent has its own email address for sharing documents and context
- **MCP Servers** - Add custom tools like Notion, Linear, and any MCP-compatible service

## Cloud Harness

Run a coding agent harness on a cloud computer, driven from your messaging app:

- **Pick Your Harness** - Choose from nine agent harnesses — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Pi, and more — and switch anytime from your settings.
- **No Laptop Needed** - The harness runs in a secure cloud sandbox with a shell, files, and internet access. Close your laptop and tasks keep running; the result arrives as a message.
- **Fast & Persistent** - Sandboxes start in seconds and your workspace is saved between tasks, so follow-up requests continue right where the last one stopped.
- **Pay As You Go** - Available to everyone: pay only for what you use with credits, or bring your own API key.

Learn more at [https://www.ezail.com/cloud-harness](https://www.ezail.com/cloud-harness).

## How It Works

1. Connect your email (Gmail or Outlook) and calendar accounts
2. Link your WhatsApp or Telegram number
3. Start chatting with Ezail via WhatsApp or Telegram
4. Your assistant handles emails, schedules meetings, makes phone calls, and completes tasks on your behalf
